buildPolicy.offlineBehavior: Bundles named modules; embeds literal module media URLs, CSS media URLs and emblem.svg. Does not read production WAV exports.
buildPolicy.webBehavior: Recursively copies index.html, src/ and all assets/. Exported WAV/SVG/PNG files are therefore downloadable in the next web build, although the runtime requests only three raster/vector image files.

legacy-key-art.method: image_gen; no reference image; opaque background; PNG copied without retouching, as recorded in source document.
legacy-key-art.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: cinematic main menu key art for an original premium 2D science-fiction walker combat game, ORDRE DE CENDRE, codename ImperiumMarch. Widescreen 16:9, high resolution. No text, no logo, no UI. Hand-painted cinematic hard-surface science-fiction concept illustration, incredible thoughtful material detail, matte painted industrial war atmosphere, nuanced cinematic light, not photoreal render, not pixel art. On the right two thirds, one enormous original two-legged imperial walking combat vehicle strides across a devastated ash desert: squat angular olive-gray armored cabin, asymmetrical sensor brow with very thin amber slit, offset cannon and ammunition drums, visible articulated hydraulic knees and broad three-toed industrial feet, believable load-bearing geometry, subtle ivory identification stripe, heavily weathered steel. A smaller low quadruped support walker far behind, silhouettes of a ruined mining outpost on the horizon and tiny logistics crew at base for scale. Background: alien planet Vesper, gigantic pale ringed planet in dusty sky, chalk cliffs, distant vertical refinery stacks, dry basalt, burnt rust-orange sunlight cutting through smoke, muted ash teal shadows. Strong readable silhouette, dramatic scale and human vulnerability. Keep left third very dark and atmospheric with open smoky sky for later typography overlay. Ground line in lower quarter. No humanoid robots, no head shaped like an animal, no recognizable Star Wars AT-AT or AT-ST design, no branded franchise elements, no gore. A premium original military science-fiction game art cover, subtle grain and masterful painted textures.
legacy-key-art.rightsDeclaration: The document declares original artwork made for this project and no extracted media from another franchise.
legacy-key-art.rightsStatus: Documented declaration; no separate asset license grant or legal opinion in the repository.

legacy-vesper-panorama.method: image_gen; no reference image; opaque background; PNG copied without retouching, as recorded in source document.
legacy-vesper-panorama.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: side-scrolling 2D game distant background panorama for original science fiction game ORDRE DE CENDRE. Ultra wide 3:1 landscape panorama, painterly 2D premium game background, no UI, no text. Alien industrial ash desert planet Vesper at dawn: desaturated slate teal sky at top fading to dust peach at horizon, giant pale planet and a very thin ring diagonally at upper left, far distant refinery silhouettes with small warm orange glows, eroded mesa cliffs and volcanic spires, heavy atmospheric perspective. Horizon and distant ground at lower 70 percent, open sky above. Foreground is empty dusty terrain in lower 25 percent, no rocks blocking a player. The playable character will be drawn separately in front. Multi-layer matte painting quality with dramatic shape design, delicate haze and exquisite texture. Distant scenery only, no humans, absolutely no walker vehicles, no robots, no cars, no spaceships. Make visual composition read as a side-view scrolling battlefield background, long continuous panorama, everything small and far away with broad open middle ground. Steel gray, muted rust, ochre, very restrained orange, sophisticated contrast, no neon. Illustration not photograph.

production-audio.method: Original authored synthesis and musical note sequences. Deterministic PCM generation. No samples, voice synthesis or third-party recordings.
production-audio.productionBrief: Produire ambiances distinctes, motifs originaux et signaux déclenchés uniquement par les faits simulés.
production-audio.rightsDeclaration: Original project code, waveforms and compositions; no licensed source recording.
production-audio.rightsStatus: Production manifest declaration; no external recording or human voice is declared.
limitations: No human voices, voice actors, pronunciation or voice lip sync delivered.
No claim of human listening approval, final mix certification, headphones/speaker coverage or auditory accessibility testing.
World loops are reusable procedural beds, not complete spatial ecosystems with every species/trade represented.
Post-rupture motif is authored but must be selected explicitly; current local choices do not reveal or trigger it.
Library montage is a listening sample, not a recording of a completed mission.
